task: Replace the full-row SELECT + merge in Conversation saves with a single targeted UPDATE of explicitly listed columns across ~21 call sites, preserving StaleDataError on missing rows and workflow materialized-history write-back (EPMCDME-15381).

key_reasoning.reason: New Conversation.update() override on the model/persistence layer plus column-list edits in ConversationService, ConversationCheckpointService, ChatNamingService, WorkflowService and the conversation/feedback/admin routers (~21 sites); base L, bumped because the change touches every conversation save flow (chat, feedback, abort, tool-call confirmation, workflow resume, rename).

Closest pattern is WorkflowConfigRepository (Core UPDATE + rowcount check) and the existing real-SQLite update test, so the mechanism is not novel; but dropping merge removes implicit diffing — non-mutable PydanticListType history with in-place edits, and get_by_id/find_by_id re-assigning materialized workflow history — so a wrong column list silently loses writes. Deleted-row error path is covered by the existing test_base_model_update_sqlite template, so no extra AC-template bump.

~9-10 source files modified (conversation.py, conversation_service.py, conversation_checkpoint_service.py, chat_naming_service.py, workflow_service.py, routers conversation/feedback/admin, config.py, tests/.env.test), ~5-6 existing test files updated for old signature/merge assertions, and 2-4 new test files (shared SQLite JSONB conftest, per-site UPDATE-count tests, behaviour tests).

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: affects multiple workflows (every conversation save path — chat, feedback, abort, tool-call checkpoint, workflow resume, rename)
